name: The Curious Case of Route 19
source:
Be careful...

Coyote Xander and wolf Julian have been dating for about nine months. Their relationship has been healthy and steady thus far, so when Julian offers the chance to visit his hometown in Utah, Xander readily accepts. The couple soon starts their trip on the desert backroad Route 19. However, they soon find themselves lost on the straight road.

[From [url=https://rhettoeraven.itch.io/the-curious-case-of-route-19]Itch.io[/url]]
